description: This file defines a set of asynchronous API utility functions for a frontend web application, including methods to perform GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE requests to a backend API. It also includes specific functions for handling work items and comments related to a project management or bug tracking system, with some logic to handle authentication headers, parsing local storage for user info, and constructing request payloads.

methods.name: withAuthHeaders(extra = {})
methods.description: Helper function to build request headers including Authorization if available.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Deletes a resource at specified path.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body to the API.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs a GET request with optional query parameters.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body to the API.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item identified by project_id and id.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author ID from localStorage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items, optionally filtered by projectId.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, including creator info from localStorage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs full URL for given API path.
